title: Chapter 1250: 10: The Terrifying Lin Yuan (Requesting Early Monthly Votes)

Chapter 1250: 10: The Terrifying Lin Yuan (Requesting Early Monthly Votes)

Chapter 1250: Chapter 10: The Terrifying Lin Yuan (Requesting Early Monthly Votes)

“Great Saint of the Galaxy, why don’t you come out quickly and meet us?”

The terrifying sound wave rippled through time and space, and at this moment, every living being on the Galaxy Chaos Continent heard this voice.

In fact, it wasn’t just the Galaxy Chaos Continent; a vast expanse of the surrounding void was covered by this sound wave. As a supreme Great Saint, the emaciated figure’s shout spread too broadly.

The bald man behind him looked on calmly, without any opinions.

Although the Great Saint of the Galaxy is not a supreme Great Saint, with the performance of his combat power in the Xuanhuang Universe, it is estimated that he is close to being a supreme Great Saint.

Although the two supreme Great Saints are fearless, they cannot easily delve into the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

The Galaxy Chaos Continent was established by the Great Saint of the Galaxy; it is his dojo. In the Galaxy Chaos Continent, the Great Saint of the Galaxy can exert even stronger power, whereas these outsiders will be suppressed.

Under such circumstances of increase and decrease, the bald man naturally wouldn’t enter it voluntarily.

In the eyes of the two supreme Great Saints, the Great Saint of the Galaxy is ultimately just a Chaos Great Saint, but they are supreme Great Saints, and they follow ‘Luo Hou Great Saint’.

The Luo Hou Great Saint is about to sweep through the Chaos Void with the testimony of the name ‘Invincible’, and they follow the Luo Hou Great Saint. Their status and position are naturally not comparable to ordinary Great Saints, so they don’t need to be too polite to the Great Saint of the Galaxy.

In the Chaos Void, the Invincible Great Saint does not appear for many eras, and once it does, it is absolutely invincible and domineering.

Whether it is His Majesty the Xuanhuang or the Moyu Tower Master, after possessing the power of the Invincible Great Saint, they do not care much about the ideas of other Great Saints.

“Who is asking the Great Saint of the Galaxy to come out for a look?”

“Supreme Great Saint, this kind of time and space suppression can only be achieved by a supreme Great Saint.”

“Is there a supreme Great Saint wanting to see the Great Saint of the Galaxy?”

On the Galaxy Chaos Continent, countless strong individuals lifted their heads to look at the source of the sound wave, including many Chaos Realm peak masters who clearly sensed the suppression of time and space and inferred that the visitor was a supreme Great Saint.

In fact, even if they did not sense the suppression of time and space, many masters guessed it was a supreme Great Saint speaking.

Apart from the supreme Great Saint, who else would dare speak to the Great Saint of the Galaxy in such a manner?

It is known that, with the power of the Great Saint of the Galaxy, it is not difficult for him to suppress other Chaos Great Saints, as the examples of the Dual Origin Great Saint and the Black Light Great Saint show.

…

“Is it those two little ones?”

From a far more distant place, several special consciousnesses descended, watching from afar the emaciated figure and the bald man, the two supreme Great Saints.

In the minds of many special existences, Lin Yuan is very likely to rank among the top five, or even the top three, Invincible Great Saints in Chaos Void history, so they naturally pay close attention.

Especially not long ago, when Lin Yuan evolved the path of Chaos Power, imprinting the Chaos Void; it was then estimated that he had nearly the Invincible Great Saint’s strength, or perhaps simply the Invincible Great Saint’s power.

“These two little ones, they should have come into contact with Luo Hou.”

“Luo Hou, huh? Unexpectedly, he should have already mastered that heritage and possesses the Invincible Great Saint’s strength. Unfortunately, in this era, there is the Great Saint of the Galaxy…”

One special consciousness slightly shook its head.

Normally, in the Chaos Void, a supreme Great Saint who has mastered a certain thirteenth-level heritage will have the strength of an Invincible Great Saint.

But possessing the Invincible Great Saint’s strength and being able to become an Invincible Great Saint are two different matters. Only one Invincible Great Saint can emerge in an era, and even if ten Great Saints with the Invincible Great Saint’s strength exist in the same era, only one Invincible Great Saint will be born.

Of course, the most likely outcome when ten share the same era, and all have the Invincible Great Saint’s strength, is that no Invincible Great Saint can arise.

After all, becoming an Invincible Great Saint requires making all other supreme Great Saints submit wholeheartedly, which is impossible if ten supreme Great Saints of the same level are present and their power differences aren’t too big.

In this situation, even if they possess the Invincible Great Saint’s strength, it’s impossible to give birth to an Invincible Great Saint recognized by many supreme Great Saints.

Because they cannot achieve absolute invincibility.

“Not necessarily, Luo Hou has a strong foundation, and the Great Saint of the Galaxy’s potential is terrifying. But in this era, with Luo Hou around, the Great Saint of the Galaxy may not successfully become an Invincible Great Saint that easily.”

Another special consciousness evaluated, they fully acknowledged the potential of the Great Saint of the Galaxy, but also acknowledged Luo Hou Great Saint as not simple.

Both Great Saints undoubtedly possess the Invincible Great Saint’s strength, but whether the Great Saint of the Galaxy can ultimately suppress Luo Hou Great Saint is another matter.

“Let’s wait and see.”

“These two little ones probably don’t know the Great Saint of the Galaxy’s strength, which is interesting. Perhaps the Galaxy and Luo Hou will meet ahead of time.”

The various special consciousnesses were intrigued. In the long Cosmic Era, it was extremely rare and valuable for a supreme Great Saint with the Invincible Great Saint’s strength to appear, and now two have emerged in this era.

Many special existences are naturally very interested.

For them, there aren’t many joys in the long years; watching the struggles between supreme Great Saints of such strength is certainly one of them.

…

Deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan was in seclusion cultivating; the high heritage given to him by the progenitors of the Source World all required vast time and effort to comprehend.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan heard the voice from outside and slightly furrowed his brows.

“Is it them?”

Lin Yuan looked at the two supreme Great Saints standing in the distant void, flashed in figure, and appeared above the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

“Great Saint of the Galaxy?”

The emaciated figure saw Lin Yuan, and faintly sensed something amiss. The aura of this Great Saint of the Galaxy was too calm, so calm that he could not feel the slightest bit.

“This Galaxy Great Saint is not simple.”

The bald man behind him also faintly senses something. He steps forward, aligning himself with the lean figure, his expression extremely solemn.

For some reason, the Galaxy Great Saint in the distance reminds him of the feeling he gets from Luo Hou Great Saint.

“Within the Xuanhuang Universe, the Galaxy Great Saint was suppressed by the Jade Qilin Great Saint like that and still hiding his strength?”

The bald man finds it incredible. He and the lean man definitely investigated the Galaxy Great Saint thoroughly before daring to come here to inquire.

“They shouldn’t have been so reckless.”

The bald man feels a bit regretful in his heart. Had he known the Galaxy Great Saint was hiding so deeply, they wouldn’t have come to investigate matters related to the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix with such an attitude.

“What do you want from me?”

Lin Yuan looked at the two extraordinary Great Saints, having been interrupted from his cultivation and understanding. Naturally, he was not in a good mood.

“Actually, it’s nothing major.”

The bald man glanced at the lean figure, then spoke up voluntarily, “Recently, we sensed the complete disappearance of the karma of the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix, so we intended to investigate and ask the Galaxy Great Saint about it…”

The bald man looks at Lin Yuan with a smile and says, “Now it seems, it was a misunderstanding.”

“It’s not a misunderstanding.” Lin Yuan shook his head and said, “I killed them both.”

Though the Nine Phoenix Great Saint self-destructed, at the root of it, it was due to Lin Yuan.

“Hmm?”

The lean figure is a bit stunned. They had initially come to report to Luo Hou Great Saint, but unexpectedly found the real culprit behind the complete disappearance of the karma of the two Great Saints, Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix.

The bald man beside him looked heavy. Even though they had clarified the matter as instructed by Luo Hou Great Saint, he didn’t feel relaxed at all.

Because Lin Yuan admitted that he killed the two Great Saints, completely obliterated them? Eliminated all karma?

Such strength, even the Invincible Great Saint might not necessarily accomplish, yet the Galaxy Great Saint did it?

“Hahaha, since it was done by the Galaxy Great Saint, we understand now and won’t disturb you further.”

The bald man immediately spoke up, intending to leave swiftly.

The lean figure beside him thought likewise, realizing the seriousness of the matter.

Completely annihilate two Great Saints? Even if they were newly ascended Great Saints, it’s extremely astonishing.

“You’ve understood your problem, now it’s my turn.” Lin Yuan looked at the two extraordinary Great Saints, the surrounding space-time subtly beginning to thicken and suppress, “You’ve disturbed my practice. Take a blow from me, survive it, and you may leave.”

“Galaxy Great Saint…” The bald man’s face turned ugly as he also felt the oppression of space-time, knowing he couldn’t leave easily.

“Galaxy Great Saint, we serve Luo Hou Great Saint…” The lean figure beside him spoke up; few ancient beings know the terror of ‘Luo Hou Great Saint’.

Even if it’s unclear that Luo Hou Great Saint has cultivated to a certain thirteenth level, he is close to being an Invincible Great Saint.

However.

Before the two extraordinary Great Saints could say anything further.

They found Lin Yuan had vanished, and in his place was an eternal Fierce Sun spanning across heavy space-time.

“No—” The lean figure felt his heart tremble in despair.

The bald man felt the same; they hesitated not a bit to crush a token inscribed with the characters Luo Hou, gifted by Luo Hou Great Saint.

When working for Luo Hou Great Saint, encountering difficult opponents, one can crush this token, at which time one of Luo Hou Great Saint’s avatars will coalesce.

This was indeed their trump card given by Luo Hou Great Saint.

Luo Hou Great Saint’s avatar, while not as powerful as the true body, is still stronger than ordinary extraordinary Great Saints, and possesses Luo Hou Great Saint’s mental will, making its power even more terrifying.

Whoosh.

The light of the Fierce Sun is omnipresent.

And as the token was crushed, waves of energy gathered to form a gigantic silhouette.

The gigantic silhouette was entirely composed of gray mist, with its aura penetrating into the depths of space-time.

“What’s the matter…”

The moment the gigantic silhouette coalesced, the mental will of Luo Hou Great Saint descended. Though he hadn’t perceived the surrounding situation yet, he felt the blazing eternal Fierce Sun from beyond the heavy space-time.

“What is that?”

The pupils of the gigantic silhouette contracted tightly.

But before any reaction was made, the gigantic silhouette rapidly collapsed under the radiance of the Fierce Sun, and along with the two extraordinary Great Saints behind him, completely vanished without a trace.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s shape returned, stretching out his right hand to collect the spoils left by the two extraordinary Great Saints, recalling the sentence that the lean figure had just said.

“Luo Hou Great Saint? Never heard of him.”

Lin Yuan was indifferent. He eliminated the main combat bodies of the lean figure and the bald man, as a warning to prevent any extraordinary Great Saints from disturbing him like this again.

Having done these, Lin Yuan’s form vanished, entering closed cultivation again deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent.
